# Synthetic: two servers (srv0, srv1) with three handlers each. Handler values differ, the
# largest is the outermost one. srv0 has 5xx on two handlers and several 5xx codes.
# HELP caddy_http_requests_in_flight Number of requests currently handled by this server.
